# ThanhNguyxnOrg

> Independent technology practice building developer tools, AI workflows, and open source utilities. 16 public repositories, 10 stars, 7 forks, 0 open issues, 5 live demos, 2 npm packages with 313 downloads in 30 days (snapshot 2026-10-11).

ThanhNguyxnOrg is not a company. It is a working base and long-term archive for projects that matter to its maintainers. Numbers on this page refresh daily from the GitHub and npm APIs; each figure carries its fetch date on the site. Nothing here is invented: thin histories stay thin, dead links stay unlinked.

## Projects

- [blendops](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/blendops): AI-native Blender workflow and skill pack, org-native sprint April to May 2026.
- [lumeo](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/lumeo): Bilingual captions and live AI dubbing for YouTube, now at v2.0.6.
- [apidex-hub](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/apidex-hub): Curated free-API catalog with a daily dead-link hygiene pipeline.
- [awesome-cert-sherpa](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/awesome-cert-sherpa): Community IT cert prep with 1,590+ original practice questions.
- [Snapbooth](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/Snapbooth): Private browser photobooth, oldest repo, rebuilt as React studio in 2026.
- [StepDSA](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/StepDSA): Interactive DSA visualizer with a deterministic time-travel engine.
- [cogmint](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/cogmint): Dark control plane for Claude Code orchestration.
- [ForgeHelm](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/ForgeHelm): Chrome extension for bulk GitHub repository management.
- [git-account-switcher](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/git-account-switcher): One-command Git identity and CLI auth switcher.
- [judgeloom-core](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/judgeloom-core): Competitive programming judge on Django and Postgres.
- [lagvex](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/lagvex): Game latency reducer with WinTun and Go relay.
- [LayoutLingua](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/LayoutLingua): PDF translator preserving layout, math and tables.
- [Locsight](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/Locsight): Codebase health analyzer on Rust and Tauri.
- [PurgeKit](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/PurgeKit): Developer-focused Windows uninstaller, v1.0.0 a day after landing.
- [SkillGauge](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/SkillGauge): Static auditor and leaderboard for agent skills.
- [.github](https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/.github): Org profile and community files, the control room.
